info.description: LHCHub home-services marketplace API (Go backend). Clients post jobs, vetted providers apply, and payment is held in escrow.
info.title: LHCHub API

post.description: Disables 2FA for the current user.
Generates a TOTP secret and backup codes for the current user.
Verifies a TOTP or backup code against a preAuthToken and issues JWT tokens.
Confirms a TOTP code and activates 2FA for the current user.
Exchanges a Google authorization code for tokens, links/finds the account by email, and returns a JWT pair.
Authenticates with email + password. Users with 2FA enabled receive a preAuthToken instead of tokens.
Stateless under JWT; always succeeds.
Emails a one-time code for verification.
Verifies a one-time code sent by email.
Changes the current user's password.
Emails a password-reset link. Always returns success to avoid leaking registered emails.
Resets the password using a uid + token from the reset email.
Creates a new account and returns JWT tokens.
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access/refresh pair.
Checks that an access token is valid.
